items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Chink Martin played in it and Freddie Newman and Charlie Cordella and Sidney Ayrton played together. ... And the only one I remember in that band was Chink Martin's brother who played bass.

ctx.x: I guess it was after the war.
Well Chink was very active for a long time. He played with all the best bands around town.
He had some talent around him in his day.
